Our robotics society needed somewhere to run simulation jobs other than one shared laptop, so three old office desktops became a three-node k3s cluster. The aim was for members to run simulation jobs without fighting over one laptop.

documents.text:
Dear Graphcore hiring team,

I am applying for the Graduate Cloud Platform Engineer 2027 role at Graphcore.

Mira set up a three-node k3s cluster for our robotics society, and I wrote the containerd proxy fix. Members could run simulation jobs without fighting over one laptop.

Pods could not pull images for a whole week. The university proxy settings were missing from containerd. We fixed it in the end.

Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards, Ellie
